ability_scale: Each task is independently normalized to mean 0 and standard deviation 1.
score_interpretation: Per-task scores are the mean over all params items of the observed response on subset items the model answered and the fixed-item 2PL probability on the rest; predicted_score_error covers only the rest. Tasks in params prediction_corrections are then corrected linearly toward the panel's full-run scores (uncorrected_score keeps the raw value). Model predicted_score is population-item-weighted.
